paraphrase: Controls of the naming/veracity/revelation/authority batch: one finite model in which every premise and conclusion of the batch holds, with a God that has the classical attributes, founds the Church and causes the being of the other being; and, for each premise of the four target-reaching steps (veracity, authority, revelation, operation naming), a finite model of the other premises in which the conclusion fails. Formal-schema models only.
